exact_statement: Determine both public questions: whether a universal c>0 gives, for every n, a nonzero signed harmonic sum smaller than c*2^(-n), and whether for all sufficiently large n every nonzero signed harmonic sum is strictly greater than 1/lcm(1,...,n).
scope_notes: Official page checked 2026-08-25: OPEN, zero claimed proofs.
This round focuses on the strict-lower-bound question, but resolving only a finite range or only a modular sufficient condition does not close the compound public problem.
Both signs on the equality boundary are equivalent by negating all coefficients.
